summary: This clinical trial looked at how a combination of low-dose semaglutide and metformin compares to metformin alone in women with polycystic ovary syndrome and obesity. Polycystic ovary syndrome is a common hormone disorder that often includes obesity. The study has been marked as completed. A total of 31 participants took part in the research.

facts.sponsor: Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujib Medical University, Dhaka, Bangladesh
